blocks.html: Harnessing the power of data and technology to advocate for sustainable paper consumption in the academic setting—one school and one student at a time.
“Harnessing the power of data and technology to advocate for sustainable paper consumption in the academic setting—one school at a time.”

A Sustainable Future was founded on the basis of protecting our planet--starting with our schools. Every student deserves the opportunity to make lasting environmental contributions in academia. Hence, here at A Sustainable Future, we provide students with the resources to educate themselves and others on the importance of sustainable consumption.

Paper Consumption Model: advanced data-analysis tool that predicts and tailors a school’s paper usage for sustainable, cost-effective printing practices

  • Nationally-trained data analysis tool 

  • Sustainable, cost-effective printing practices
Paper Consumption Program: engages students in a research-based curriculum to create, present, and implement an original Paper Consumption Model (PCM) designed for their school

1. Tech-enabled

  2. Data-driven

  3. Student-centered

​

ASF mitigates academic paper waste and facilitates the growth of students as environmental activists.
